Improper preposition governing Ἰερουσαλήμ. The ASV gives the governed name no determiner for an article to anchor, so the adverb keeps its trailing English preposition whole, exactly as ἐγγὺς τοῦ Σαλείμ → near to Salim does (rules 42, 101); rule 71 heads such a unit on the word rendering the adverb itself. Giving 'to' to the name as a supplied case preposition was the earlier reading, but rule 101 says in terms that no corpus unit puts such a trailing preposition on a bare governed noun.
